_comment: Tunable values only. Secrets (Dhan token, VAPID keys) live in .env, never here.
_dataSource_comment: 'nse_free' = no signup needed, temporary, NIFTY/BANKNIFTY only (SENSEX is BSE-listed, not on NSE's feed). 'dhan' = your real target: official, low-latency, supports SENSEX. You have F&O activated and real credentials now, so this is set to 'dhan'.
_strikesEachSide_comment: How many strikes above/below the at-the-money strike to track. 3 = ATM + 3 up + 3 down = 7 strikes total.
_pollIntervalMs_comment: Observed production 429 responses show this Dhan account must treat Option Chain as one global request every 3 seconds. The backend serializes every underlying and uses a 100ms safety buffer; event-driven chart updates still come only from the active-band WebSocket.
_optionChainRateLimitBackoffMs_comment: After an observed Dhan 429, pause all Option Chain REST work before the next serialized request rather than retrying immediately.
_liveFeedFreshnessMs_comment: A connected Dhan stream only overrides a REST reconciliation failure after it has delivered a recent packet. This prevents misleading LIVE status on a silent socket.
_historyPersistIntervalMs_comment: When OI_HISTORY_DATABASE_URL is configured, compact raw snapshots are written at this interval for restart-safe 5m/30m/3h recovery. In-memory live calculations still use every event bucket.
_chartHistoryMaxMs_comment: Compact near-ATM chart points retained independently from raw OI snapshots: 10 hours of event-driven Dhan live-feed updates, coalesced into short browser-safe time buckets.
_liveFeedEnabled_comment: When dataSource is dhan, use the authenticated server-side Full Packet WebSocket for active ATM-band price/OI/volume/5-level depth. Option Chain REST remains every 3s for full-chain context and reconciliation.
_liveFeedEventBucketMs_comment: Replace repeated chart points inside this short bucket; preserves responsive event-driven history without several same-second points competing for one chart timestamp.
_thresholds_comment: Notification fires when the combined OI change across the tracked 7-strike band (ATM +/-3) crosses this many contracts, for that window. Set per window since 5m moves are naturally smaller than 3h moves.
_notifyCooldownMs_comment: Minimum gap between two notifications for the same symbol+window, so a sustained move above threshold doesn't spam you every poll cycle.
_paperTrading_comment: Paper-only simulator defaults. Screen controls can persist enabled state, per-symbol enablement, allowed lot count, trigger level, target, stop-loss, lifetime, and cooldown when PostgreSQL is configured. No broker connection or Dhan order endpoint is used.

paperTrading._contractLotSizes_comment: Current contract units per lot, verified against the public Dhan instrument master on 24 Aug 2026. NIFTY active option rows are 65 units per lot and SENSEX active option rows are 20. Update these when the exchange/Dhan master changes; each new paper trade stores its multiplier at entry.
